component.name: filebot-j21
component.summary: The ultimate tool for organizing and renaming your movies, TV shows, and anime

description.p: FileBot is the ultimate tool for organizing and renaming your Movies, TV Shows, and Anime, as well as fetching subtitles and artwork. It makes organizing your media files a breeze! FileBot matches your files against online databases such as TheMovieDB and AniDB.

ul.li: A simple user-interface tuned for drag-and-drop
Rename hundreds of media files in matter of seconds
Fetch episode lists from TheMovieDB and AniDB
Powerful and full-featured format expression engine
